instruction: Retrieve employee performance data from the Excel file and fill out the PDF review template for each employee, including all details and ratings marked with '√'. Save each completed evaluation as a separate PDF named after the employee, starting with Michael Brown.

metadata.explanation: This task verifies that the PDF evaluation form for Michael Brown is properly completed with employee data from the Excel file. The evaluator checks: (1) file exists at expected path, (2) has exactly 1 page matching template structure, (3) contains employee name 'Michael Brown', (4) contains checkmark symbols (√) indicating ratings are filled, and (5) contains performance-related content confirming the form is populated, not blank.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file existence and page count (1 page)
Evaluator extracts PDF text content and checks for employee name 'Michael Brown'
Evaluator checks for checkmark symbols (√, ✓, X, x, ☑, ✔) indicating ratings are marked
Evaluator checks for rating-related keywords (rating, performance, evaluation, review, score) to confirm form is populated
The getter uses pypdf to extract text and perform semantic content checks, not just structural validation
The metric validates all four requirements: page_count, requires_employee_name, requires_checkmarks, requires_ratings
Can distinguish between completed form and blank PDF by checking for name, checkmarks, and rating content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Rating verification uses keyword detection which is somewhat weak - doesn't verify actual rating values are correct from Excel data
Minor: Checkmark detection doesn't verify they're in the correct locations for specific rating categories
Minor: Doesn't explicitly verify 'reviewer details' section is filled (only checks general rating keywords)
Minor: Doesn't verify specific performance data values were correctly transferred from Excel (e.g., numeric scores, dates)
